37 L 25 K (14 J 2) L (2 J 13) K (62 I 31) = ?

37 + 25 - (14 × 2) + (2 × 13) - (62 ÷ 31) = ?

Applying the **BODMAS rule** i.e. **Bracket of Division Multiplication Addition Subtraction.**

We get,

= 37 + 25 - (28) + (26) - (2) 

= __**37 + 25 **__- 28 __**+ 26**__ - 2

= 88 __**- 28 - 2**__

Hence, **the correct answer is 58.**
